title.narrative: Fourth Greater Mekong Subregion Corridor Towns Development Project

description.narrative: The project will support the government of the Lao PDR in improving urban environmental services and enhance regional economic connectivity in the towns of Paksan and Thakhek, two towns located along the North-South Economic Corridor in the Greater Mekong Subregion (GMS). It will finance: (i) sewage networks and eight small-scale wastewater treatment facilities to improve sanitation; (ii) two controlled landfills and solid waste collection vehicles for municipal waste to improve waste collection and management, (iii) improved drainage and riverbank protection, (iv) rehabilitation of the old-town center to promote regional tourism in Thakhek, and; (v) city master plans to promote regional economic connectivity. The project will accelerate urban node development along the GMS North-South Economic Corridor in Lao PDR.

Output: Institutional effectiveness improved Indicator: 25 government staff reported increased knowledge of urban service delivery, asset management, and operation and maintenance of urban facilities and other institutional arrangements for improving service delivery (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Being implemented. The project training masterplan has been developed. The PIC has conducted 12 on-the-job training courses for PCU, PIUs, and Contractors. Data Source: Evaluation of training sessions and/or workshops by participants Actual value:

Output: Institutional effectiveness improved Indicator: At least 30% of PIU staff will be women (2017 baseline: 0%) Achievement: 35 Progress/Status: Achieved. The PIUs have 29 staff, including 15 women (51.7%). Women's representation in Thakhek and Paksan are 53.8% (7/13) and 50.0% (8/16), respectively. Data Source: Evaluation of training sessions and/or workshops by participants

The survey for collecting data for tariff roadmap, O&M and CP was conducted in July 2022. The Tariff Road Map and Corporate Plan (including for O&M fund) preparation is ongoing. Corporate plan specialist is recruited. Data Source: Draft business plans for UDAAs Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Output: Institutional effectiveness improved Indicator: Urban development strategy and master plan, with climate-resilience and gender- responsive measures, developed and approved for Paksan and Thakhek. (2017 baseline: not available) Progress/Status: Being implemented. The UDMP support consultant contract was signed on 11 Nov 2022. The updated inception report was completed and submitted on 28 Mar 2023. Topographic survey was completed. The Consultant is now preparing the draft Master plan and the 1st consultation workshop was held in the end of Nov 2023, and 2nd consultation workshop was held in July 2024. The final D5-D6 products of UDMP for Paksan and Thakhek submitted in August 2024. The Final Public Consultation for the Urban Development Master Plan (UDMP) of the Paksan and Thakhek towns conducted in December 2024. Khammouane and Bolikhamxay provinces approved the UDMP by December 2025. Data Source: Draft master plans Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y
